assegno_sociale.note: Annual value of the assegno sociale (social allowance), the reference minimum-income figure used across multiple Italian immigration routes -- the EU long-term residence permit (permesso di soggiorno UE per soggiornanti di lungo periodo) and family reunification (ricongiungimento familiare) both peg their income tests to this figure, increased by set percentages per additional family member per Art. 29 comma 3 of the Testo Unico Immigrazione. The elective-residency visa (it_elective_residency) uses a separate, larger reference figure (3x a different subsistence table under Decreto Interministeriale MAE 850/2011), not this one.

sources.title: Immigrafacile -- Permesso Soggiorno Lungo Periodo 2026: Requisiti e Reddito, citing the 2026 assegno sociale figure of approximately EUR 6,542.51/year. The underlying INPS (Istituto Nazionale della Previdenza Sociale) figure that sets this amount annually was not independently fetched in this research pass
